knowledge.purpose: Drag-and-drop file selection area with click-to-browse fallback and file-name preview. Inside a form, a picked file goes with the write; a record with no file field refuses it (a validation failure naming the field)
useCases: Attach documents to a form or ticket
Bulk CSV / data import drop target
antiPatterns: Inside a bound form whose record has no file field — the write is refused before sending (validation, naming this field) and the dropzone warns in the console; do not promise the file is kept
Single short text value — use form.input
Choosing from existing items — use form.select or form.combobox
knowledge.implementation:
A record write carries the record's fields as JSON, not files (data-protocol §4.1): the foundation form posts JSON, a File serialises to {}, so the form LEAVES FILE FIELDS OUT of its payload and a dropzone placed inside a form logs a one-time console warning for the developer. The picked file names are emitted on input:change (payload.names), so a page may show them, but nothing reaches the record. Keep the dropzone out of bound forms (settings, sign-up), or say on the page that the file is not kept.

Further use cases:
- Media asset upload in a content editor that sends the file itself

jsonSchema.description: Name of the file input. Dropped and picked files are both attached to it.
Accepted types (".png", "image/*", "image/png"). A file that does not match is refused with a visible message.
Largest accepted file in MB; 0 = no limit. A larger file is refused with a visible message.
